hooks.name: New File Header
hooks.description: When a new .js file is created, adds a standard BrickBlast header comment block at the top.

action.prompt:
A new JavaScript file has been created for the BrickBlast project.

Automatically add the following header comment at the top of the file:

```javascript
/**
 * BrickBlast - [filename]
 *
 * [Brief description of what this file contains - infer from filename]
 *
 * Part of the BrickBlast browser game project.
 * Uses vanilla JavaScript with the HTML5 Canvas API.
 */
```
